newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial firms sack 1,596 on Nov 18-23.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial firms sack 1,596 on Nov 18-23.

text.p: Private industrial firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 1,596 employees between Nov 18 and Nov 23, a spokesman for the Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said.
In the previous week, Sao Paulo's industries sacked 378 workers.
Fifteen out of the 46 sectors included in the survey sacked personnel in the period. Five hired new people and 26 maintained their staff unchanged, he said.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 165,266 workers or 7.74 percent of the Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, the spokesman said.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 206,345 workers, or 9.39 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, he added.
